description: Land Title Settlement Department - Manalkanda, Puttalam D/S Division, Puttalam District - Cad. Map No. 410111 and other land parcels
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of multiple "NOTICE CALLING FOR CLAIMS TO LAND PARCELS" announcements under the Registration of Title Act. The notices specifically deal with land ownership claims, cadastral maps, land parcels in various districts, and the process for determining land titles. This falls squarely under Land Gazettes (Type 4) which cover "land registrations, property ownership, land titles" and "land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals."
